metadata.description: The Agentic Development Lifecycle toolkit, packaged for Claude Code.

plugins.name: adlc
plugins.description: Embrace the ADLC from inside Claude Code: a phase-routing discovery skill, commands to bootstrap (.adlc/) and author/interrogate/prosecute tickets, and enforcing PreToolUse gates (rails-guard, build-gate) that can deny edits in ADLC-initialized repositories. Requires the @adlc/cli gate toolkit (npm i -g @adlc/cli).
